Aditya — thanks for sending the draft. The team reviewed and we have a couple of open items specifically around publicity and confidential information that need to be resolved before legal signs off. High-level:

- Logo & reference rights: Acme is comfortable with being listed as a customer, but we need control over logo usage and a short approval window for assets (we typically ask for 7 business days).
- Press/announcement: We prefer mutual announcement language and a 14-day review window prior to any press release.
- Confidentiality carve-outs: we will not accept broad carve-outs that allow benchmarking or metric-sharing that identify Acme. Aggregated, non-identifiable metrics are ok, but we need explicit language.

Attached: ACME_Redlines.pdf (redlines annotated).

Hi all — reviewed Bryan's notes and the attached redlines. Below are proposed compromise edits that should be acceptable to Acme while protecting Redwood's ability to reference customers for go-to-market. I attached a tracked-redline too (Redlines_Aditya_v1.docx).

1) Logo use & approval SLA (Publicity clause) — Proposed insertion:
"Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use Customer's name and logo as a reference to Redwood in Redwood's marketing materials and customer lists. Prior to public use of Customer-branded assets, Redwood will provide Customer a single asset packet and Customer will have seven (7) business days to approve or request reasonable edits. Failure to respond within seven (7) business days will be deemed approval."

Rationale: firm SLA prevents indefinite hold-ups. We avoid 'unreasonable withholding' language which can be subjective; explicit deeming helps ops.

2) Mutual announcement (Press release) — Proposed insertion:
"Any public announcement regarding the existence of the parties' business relationship shall be mutual and made only with the prior written consent of both parties, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld. The party seeking to make an announcement will provide the other party with a draft and related materials at least fourteen (14) calendar days before public release. The receiving party will deliver approval or proposed edits within fourteen (14) calendar days."

Rationale: keeps mutuality and gives both sides a clear window.

3) Confidentiality carve-out for aggregated metrics (Benchmarking) — Proposed insertion:
"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, the parties agree that Provider may aggregate and anonymize operational metrics and use such aggregated, non-identifiable benchmarking data for internal product improvements and de-identified case studies, provided that such data cannot be reasonably attributed to Customer. Provider will not publish Customer-specific performance metrics without Customer's express written consent."

Rationale: preserves our product analytics and case-study use while protecting customer identity.

4) Ops ask (Marissa) — suggest we include a templated 'asset packet' requirement in the SOW: file formats, primary logo, color-safe versions, and a single PR contact. Marissa, can you confirm the template and estimated turnaround SLAs?

If Ben/Aditya are comfortable, I'll produce a clean tracked redline and send back to Bryan + Karen with a covering note that we accepted the 7-business-day logo SLA and 14-day announcement window in exchange for the anonymized benchmarking carve-out.

--
Laura Bennett
